task_intent: Redesign a personal website homepage for a product leader and founder
coverage_limits: Sixteen sections kept from eight section searches of five or six results each. This is a sample, not a survey of the library.
Five results returned a blank frame and were not used.

The 'bento grid presenting products or projects' query returned no true bento. The second query, 'features bento grid with cards of different sizes', returned feature grids, which are analogies for a project bento.
No personal website of an individual product leader appeared in the results. Hero references are company and agency pages.
All references are still images. Motion, hover and video behaviour were not observed.
Image files were downloaded successfully. The canonical Mobbin links were not opened to verify them.

references.query: personal portfolio hero section with video intro
references.observation: Short text column on the left, one large rounded video frame on the right. The founder is on camera, a caption is burned into the frame, and a small pill in the corner names the video.

references.query: personal portfolio hero section with video intro
references.observation: Two-line headline that ends in a full stop, a one-sentence subhead, and a round play button with a text label beside it. The media block sits to the right.

references.query: founder personal website hero with portrait photo and short bio
references.observation: Two equal tiles side by side: a flat colour tile carrying a short founder bio in large type, and a portrait photo. Both have the same radius and height.

references.query: founder personal website hero with portrait photo and short bio
references.observation: Condensed heavy headline, a small mono caps line under it, then a plain first-person paragraph with a slim facts column on the right (location, link).

references.query: agency selected work case studies section
references.observation: A large tile about two thirds wide beside a narrower tile. Images fill the tiles edge to edge with a 16 to 20px radius, and the client name and one-line description sit under the image, not on top of it. Filter chips sit above the grid.

references.query: features bento grid with cards of different sizes
references.observation: Tiles in saturated flat colours (blue, violet, orange, pale grey) with the title and two lines of copy at the bottom-left and an object floating in the upper half.

references.query: features bento grid with cards of different sizes
references.observation: Tiles with a very large radius in pale tints (blue, lilac, peach, mint). A product screenshot sits inside each tile on its own rounded card and a one-word label sits below it.

references.query: agency selected work case studies section
references.observation: A horizontal row of projects, each shown as a small app-icon square with the name and a four-word descriptor under it, separated by thin vertical rules.

references.query: agency selected work case studies section
references.observation: A short intro and button on the left, then tall portrait cards that run off the right edge of the page to signal a horizontal scroll.
Twelve logos in two rows of six, all in solid black, evenly spaced, with no heading and generous space above and below.
One row of eight logos in a muted grey on white. The strip is thin and quiet.
A small centred caption above a single row of logos that is cut off at both edges, which shows the row is moving.

One wide featured card with a video thumbnail on the left and the title, date and a 'Watch' link on the right. Two smaller cards below pair a thumbnail with a title and a 'Read' link. A small tag sits above each title.
Three-column article grid with a cover image, a mono caps category in the accent colour, the title, then author and reading time. A dark subscribe tile takes one grid slot.

references.query: creator shop section selling templates and digital products
references.observation: Three columns. Each product is a cover mock-up on a pale tinted square, then a title, two lines of description and an underlined text link.

references.query: creator shop section selling templates and digital products
references.observation: A dark bento: one full-width tile on top and two half-width tiles below, each with a small coloured label, a heading, two lines and a button.
